🛩️ HANGARBAY · FLIGHT PLAN FP-004 · 2026-09-04

Sheen Width Engine

Rebuild sheen's word wrapper as a real cell-width layout engine so tables and CJK text stop overflowing terminals — and deliberately not a general CSS layout system: no floats, no flexbox, no margins.

LEDE

Sheen renders HTML to terminals today, but its wrapper measures in runes, not cells. Two families of content break it: wide glyphs (CJK, emoji) that occupy two cells, and tables whose columns are wider than the viewport. Both fail silently — the worst kind of layout bug, because the user assumes the terminal ate the output.

THE BUILD

Wrapping is measurement, not splitting

The reframe: today's wrapPara decides where to break; the new engine decides what fits. Break points are a consequence of a cell budget per line (width − indent − border), computed once per paragraph against a cache[segment] → []cellRun table. Everything downstream — tables, blockquotes, list markers — consumes the same budget function instead of re-implementing arithmetic.

SPIKE THIS FIRST

The riskiest unknown is grapheme segmentation, not width tables. Whether a ZWJ emoji family emoji (U+1F468 U+200D U+1F469 U+200D U+1F466) occupies 2 cells or 4 differs by terminal, and go-runewidth and the standards disagree today. If sheen guesses wrong, every CJK/emoji doc renders misaligned — the exact bug this plan exists to kill.

Options, ranked: (1) adopt rivo/uniseg grapheme clusters + runewidth per cluster; (2) per-cluster lookup with a hand-rolled ZWJ table; (3) treat all non-ASCII as 2 cells. Timebox: two days on option 1 against Terminal.app, iTerm2, Kitty, and Alacritty. Fallback if terminals disagree irreconcilably: option 3, and document the caveat in the README.

PHASES

The sequence

01

Grapheme spike (timeboxed)

Two days, option 1 above, decision recorded in this document's footer. No other work starts until it lands.

02

Cell budget engine + wrapPara rewrite

Single budget function, cache table, ANSI-aware zero-width scanning. Prose, lists, and blockquotes migrate; tables keep the old shrinker.

ships · v0.3.0
03

Table shrink policies

Proportional shrink with 3-cell floor, ellipsis via ansi.Truncate, and the substance table's formula as a regression test.

ships · v0.3.1
04

Pre/nowrap escape hatches

Overflow tolerated for white-space: pre; nowrap paragraphs clip instead of wrap. Polish only; no new CSS surface.

HAZARDS

What can hurt

HIGH

Terminals disagree on emoji width

Blocks phase 03's table alignment for anyone living in Kitty. Mitigation: the documented fallback (all-non-ASCII = 2 cells) and a --width-ascii-only escape hatch.

MED

Scope creep into a layout engine

"Since we have a budget function, add floats" is the road to a half-finished browser. The thesis line exists to be quoted back at whoever proposes it.

MED

glow ships the same fix first

If charmbracelet lands cell-aware table rendering, sheen's differentiation shrinks to HTML input. Would hurt contributor morale more than usage; response is to ship phase 02 early and brag about CJK handling.

LOW

runewidth table licensing

MIT, same as sheen — no action, listed so nobody re-derives the question.
